summary.en: Jirokichi Suzuki bought some art pieces from someone in Hokkaido, and he wanted the potter Kenzo Ukishima to create a catalogue of the pieces, that is why Sonoko visits Ukishima’s house with the gift Jirokichi gave as a greeting. Conan is tagging along because Ran has gone shopping and he has nothing else to do. When the two arrive, they are welcomed by Ukishima holding a bandaged cat. Coincidentally, today is the day that Ukishima will move away to reorganize his work due to health issues, with some of the items not needing to be wrapped as they were bought by a collector Munetake Sawada. However, the cat almost causes a pottery vase to shatter when Ukishima opens the window. Luckily, Conan and Sonoko react in time, only for the kid to reveal that someone had broken the vase before the two arrived. Location: Kenzo Ukishima's studio Victim: Munetake Sawada Object: Pottery vase Suspects: Tomoko Natsume, Miyuki Tachibana & Katsuyuki Adachi Sawada suddenly arrives at the time and becomes angry when he sees the broken vase. He threatens to sue Ukishima and almost causes a fight with Ukishima’s former student, Katsuyuki Adachi. Conan has to knock Sawada out using the stun-gun wristwatch to temporarily ease the tension. Conan, Sonoko, Ukishima, and his students discuss who broke the vase, and use security footage to see what happened when the vase broke.
